n = int(input())
v = list(map(int, input().split()))
t = int(input())

v.sort()

ans = 0
for i in range(n):
    cur = t
    length = 1
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        if v[j] - v[j-1] > cur:
            break
        cur -= (v[j] - v[j-1])
        length += 1
    ans = max(ans, length)

print(ans)
</translated_code>
